suggested_tests: Blood tests for androgen hormones (such as testosterone)
pcos.exclusions: Doctors usually rule out other causes of irregular cycles or excess hair growth first, such as thyroid conditions, raised prolactin and adrenal conditions.
questions: My cycles are often longer than 35 days. Could this fit a pattern worth investigating?
I have persistent acne and unwanted hair growth. Are hormone tests appropriate for me?
Which tests would you suggest to rule out other causes before drawing conclusions?

delay.title: Why it is worth raising early
delay.body: Surveys of women with PCOS report that many waited over two years and saw several health professionals before getting answers. Bringing a dated log to your visit can shorten that path.
delay.source: Gibson-Helm et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2017

endo.exclusions: Doctors usually also consider other causes of pelvic pain, such as fibroids, adenomyosis, pelvic infection and bowel or bladder conditions.
questions: My period pain is severe and limits my day. Could this fit a pattern worth investigating?
Pain with intimacy or bowel or urinary symptoms around my period: should these be examined?

delay.title: Severe period pain is not something to just put up with
delay.body: Endometriosis is commonly reported to take several years from first symptoms to answers. A log of pain days and how they affect daily life helps your doctor take it seriously.
delay.source: Nnoaham et al., Fertil Steril 2011; ESHRE endometriosis guideline 2022
